title: Auth retry stop on 401/403: correct typed error stops reconnect loop
description: The AuthFailed typed error in run_sse propagates out of run_sse, is caught in spawn_sse loop, sends SseStatus::AuthError, and returns from the task without sleeping. The UI then sets quit=true. This is correct: a 401/403 will not self-resolve by reconnecting. The alternative (keep retrying with backoff on auth failure) would be a DoS on the server. Defend against 'why not just retry like all other errors'.
